transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess… work, mostly. I’m having a hard time keeping my focus lately. Like I’ll be trying to finish an estimate or a code form, and then a tool noise, a text, or some idea about the workshop pulls me off. Then I come back and things are mixed up. It’s started causing problems, so… I figured I should come in.
How long have you been having trouble keeping your focus?
About seven months, I guess. It started building up after we took on the mortgage for the workshop and the equipment.
Do you often find yourself fidgeting or feeling restless when you're sitting still?

Yeah… I mean, I don’t know if it’s fidgeting exactly, but sitting still feels kind of like I’m wasting time. I’ll go from job sites to bids, then end up in the workshop messing with test panels or starting some home-automation thing before I’ve even finished the last one. It’s hard to just stop.
Do you often act on impulse without thinking things through?
I’m not sure. I mean… I’ll jump into things without really finishing the last thing, but I don’t know if that’s “impulse” exactly. I don’t think of myself as reckless, if that’s what you mean.
Are these difficulties with focus and restlessness affecting your relationships with family, friends, or coworkers?

Yeah… it is. Work’s been getting messy. Clients have complained about missed details and scheduling mix-ups, and my apprentices don’t really seem to trust what I’m telling them like they used to.

At home… it’s been tense. My wife and I keep arguing about the mortgage and the business. She thinks I’m putting everything at risk.
Have you always had trouble with focus and restlessness, or is this something that started more recently in your life?

More recently, I guess. I wasn’t always like this.

It’s been… building for maybe seven months, since we took on the mortgage for the workshop and the equipment. That’s when it started getting harder to keep settled.
Did you have trouble with focus or sitting still when you were a kid?
Not really as a kid, no. This feels more like something that’s come on lately… maybe the last seven months, since we took on the mortgage and all the equipment for the workshop.
Did you ever get into trouble in school for not being able to sit still or pay attention?
No… not that I remember. I mean, I probably got distracted like any kid, but I wasn’t getting in trouble for it or anything.
Are you feeling overwhelmed or stressed by the arguments with your wife and the problems at work?

Yeah… I mean, I don’t love talking about it, but yeah.

Work’s been slipping. Clients are noticing missed details, scheduling stuff getting mixed up. Even my apprentices… they don’t really seem to trust what I’m telling them like they used to.

And at home, it’s just… the mortgage and the business keep turning into arguments. My wife thinks I’m putting everything at risk. So yeah, it’s been stressful.
Are you having difficulty completing tasks at work or at home due to your trouble with focus and restlessness?

Yeah… at work especially. I’m missing details I wouldn’t usually miss, and scheduling’s gotten mixed up enough that clients have complained.

My apprentices notice too, I think. They don’t really take my direction the same way lately.

At home it’s… mostly arguments. The mortgage, the business, all of it. My wife feels like I’m putting what we built at risk. So yeah, it’s causing problems.
Did you experience any symptoms like these when you were a teenager?
No… not really as a teenager. This is more recent. It’s been building for maybe seven months, since we took on the mortgage for the workshop and equipment.
Did you have any problems with focus, restlessness, or impulsivity as a child that your parents or teachers noticed?
Not that I know of. I mean… nobody ever made a big deal about that when I was a kid. Teachers didn’t really say anything like that, as far as I remember.
Did you have any symptoms like difficulty focusing or feeling restless when you were in elementary school?
I don’t really remember having that in elementary school. Nothing that stood out, anyway. I think I was pretty normal with school stuff.
Did any of these focus or restlessness issues start before you were 12 years old?
No… I don’t think so. This really only started building the last several months — maybe seven months — around when we took on the mortgage for the workshop and equipment.
Did you experience any of these symptoms before the age of 12?
No, not before 12. Like I said, it’s more been building over the last seven months or so, since we took on the mortgage for the workshop and equipment.
Did any of these issues with focus or restlessness start after you turned 18?
Yeah. It started as an adult… really just over the past seven months or so, after we took on the mortgage for the workshop and equipment.
Did any of these issues with focus or restlessness start before you turned 18 or only after?
Only after. It’s been… maybe about seven months, since we took on the mortgage for the workshop and equipment.
Have you had any of these symptoms consistently throughout your adult life before the last seven months?
No… I wouldn’t say consistently. It’s really just been building these last seven months or so, since the mortgage for the workshop and equipment.
Did you have any problems with focus, restlessness, or impulsivity as a young adult, before the last seven months?
No, not really. Before this… I don’t think I had problems like that. It’s more been building over the last seven months, since we took on the mortgage for the workshop and equipment.
Did you have any of these symptoms at any point between when you were 12 and about 7 years ago?
No… not that I can remember. This really only started building about seven months ago, after we took on the mortgage for the workshop and equipment.
